QuestInfo.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach
QuestInfo.0: Riel is trying to develop special dish of Florina Beach.
QuestInfo.1: I need to collect some of the recipes to develop the Special Taste of Florina Beach. I heard that #b10 #t4000136#, 10 #t4000043#, 10 #t4000044#, and 10 #t4000029##k are necessary. Will Valen's new recipe succeed?
QuestInfo.2: I'm familiar with working on Florina Beach. I visited Riel one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help Valen?

0.0: I have a job for you now. All you need to do is gather up a few materials. What do you think? Do you want to do it?

yes.0:
Drop by every once in a while, and I'll have something for you. What do you think? Isn't that cool? Valen's been trying to create some new recipes and he'll need more fresh materials. Your job is to gather up the following items. What do you think? 

 #i4000136# 10 #t4000136#s
  #i4000043# 10 #t4000043#s
#i4000044# 10 #t4000044#s
  #i4000029# 10 #t4000029#s

no.0: Oh, really? Well, it's not something I need right this minute, so take your time, and see if you want to do it. If you do, then come talk to me alright? Well, I gotta get going...

1.0: Did you gather them all up?? Let's see ...

yes.0: As usual! You're the best I've ever seen! Thanks for your help. I'll definitely be waiting for you if I find myself looking for a help. See you around.

item.0: It looks like some are missing... Can you check again?
